1. It is a Barcode Reader, Not a Lie Detector
Tools like ZeroGPT guess if text is AI based on "vibes" (how predictable the writing is). SynthID does not guess. It only checks for a highly specific, mathematical "barcode" embedded in the word choices. It only flags text if it finds that exact mathematical pattern. If you didn't use a model that actively embeds SynthID (like Google's Gemini), the detector will see absolutely nothing.2. The Watermark is Highly Fragile
Google’s own technical documentation for SynthID Text explicitly states its biggest limitation: the watermark is easily destroyed by human editing. Because the barcode relies on a specific sequence of word choices, thoroughly rewriting the text, changing the syntax, or altering the formatting shatters the mathematical pattern.
